items.title: Kristen Korb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 16, 2000
items.q: And then at night I was the bass player for Bobby Shew and Frank Mantooth was on the gig

ctx.x: The percentage of gigs that you get called for these days, are they mostly for your singing or your bass or for both? Now people can get two for one I guess.

Yeah. Well it’s interesting. Because like locally they didn’t even know I sang. Because the other musicians said, “Oh we’ve got to see you with Ray Brown, oh that’s so great, man I bet those bass duos are just cool.” It’s well actually I’m singing on the album. “You sing? We didn’t know you sang.” I play. I’m a bassist who happens to sing. So then once that was established that I actually did sing as well, then people were like “Kristen we want you to play bass, we need a bass player on this gig. Since you’re…
Yeah, and from a career standpoint it’s good too.
